root_cause: _pre_compose_validation did 'scenes = scene_plan or []'; the compose-director passes the scene_plan ARTIFACT dict, so iteration yielded its string keys and every dimension raised AttributeError, which a bare except swallowed as a log warning. The governance check had therefore never run in production.

fix.normalisation: VideoCompose._normalize_scene_plan -> (scenes, source) accepting artifact dict / list / None, reporting anything else as invalid
fix.diagnostics: structured warning carrying exception type, message and scene representation; logged with exc_info only at DEBUG; recorded on VideoCompose.last_slideshow_risk
fix.report_only: OPENMONTAGE_SLIDESHOW_RISK_ENFORCEMENT (default report_only; set to block to re-enable the preserved blocking branch)

representation_finding.why: The scorer reads scene_plan-only fields (shot_intent, narrative_role, information_role, hero_moment, shot_language). edit_decisions.cuts has additionalProperties:false and cannot carry them, so the cuts fallback is information-poor by construction.
representation_finding.latent_scorer_bug: _score_typography counts types text_card/stat_card/kpi_grid, which are Remotion CUT type names. scene_plan.type is a different enum (talking_head/broll/animation/character_scene/diagram/text_card/transition/generated/screen_recording) and only 'text_card' overlaps, so typography risk is under-counted on the canonical representation and over-counted on the cuts representation.

second_project.note: 5/5 scenes lack shot_intent and roles even though the artifact is schema-valid - optional metadata drives 10 of the 14 risk points.

output_regression.method: re-burn with identical inputs to renders/rev2b/
